# catalogue, no orders) then dt=2025-01-01 .. dt=2026-02-28. Fourteen months of
# orders, so last-year measures exist for January and February 2026. The world
# clock opens at 2026-03-02T00:00Z, a Monday - business day 1 of the February
# close.
days: 425

# out. Build time is dominated by dbt, not by volume - a 2x seed builds in about
# the same time.
customers: 220               # accounts on the platform at cutover
signup_pct: 18               # chance per day of a new account (a second at a quarter of it)
update_pct: 9                # chance per day that one account is upgraded a segment
orders_per_day: [20, 60]     # base range, scaled by weekday, month, peak days and growth
lines_per_order: [1, 4]
cancel_pct: 6                # 70% the same day, the rest the next day
refund_pct: 4                # 3 to 45 days after the order
growth_pct: 20               # year-over-year order volume growth
